_about: Decision rules: diagnosis signal -> recommended AI-agent components. `when` is a Python expression over `d` (the diagnosis JSON) plus helpers (see apply_rules.py). Components carry a kind: rule (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md line), hook (Claude Code hook), permission (allow/deny), skill, agent (subagent), mcp (MCP server), scaffold (one-time file), doc, report (to the owner), runner (infrastructure requirement). `reason` is a template filled from the diagnosis.

rules.signal: generated code present (path markers or 'auto-generated' headers)

components.name: PreToolUse deny Edit/Write under generated dirs
rule line: these paths are generated; change the source and regenerate

rules.reason: generated code in {gen_dirs}; editing it by hand is silently overwritten on the next build

components.name: first-tests scaffold (one smoke test in the native framework)
Stop hook: build/compile gate (no test gate yet)
explicitly NOT a test-writer agent: nothing to run it against

rules.reason: no test framework found ({test_files} test-like files) - an agent that 'adds tests' would invent a harness

rules.signal: test framework present with a real corpus

components.name: run-affected-tests skill ({test_cmd})
rule line: test command + where tests live

rules.reason: {test_frameworks} with {test_files} test files - the agent should run the existing suite, not write a new one

components.name: verify skill = the CI commands run locally
rule line: 'done' means the CI commands pass

rules.reason: CI ({ci_systems}, {ci_n} workflows) already encodes the project's definition of green: {ci_cmds}

components.name: local verify script (build + tests) as the only gate
report: no CI - agent output cannot be machine-checked before merge

rules.reason: no CI config found - nothing defines green, so a minimal local gate must be created before agents change code

components.name: per-package CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md (build+test per package)
which-package skill (maps a request to the owning package)
rule line: run commands from the package dir, not the root

rules.reason: {mono_ws} ({mono_n} packages) - one root instruction file cannot state the right build/test command for each

components.name: architecture note for {hot_dir}
reviewer subagent scoped to {hot_dir}

rules.reason: {hot_dir} changed {hot_changes} times by {hot_authors} authors in the sampled history - highest regression risk, no single owner

rules.signal: repeated change shapes (same >=3 files changed together >=3 times)

components.name: change-recipe skill for: {shape_example}

rules.reason: {shape_n} recurring file-sets in history - a recipe makes the agent touch all of them, not just the obvious one

components.name: deny Read on the flagged files until reviewed
PreToolUse secret-scan on Write/Edit and on git commit
report to owner: {sec_outside} hits in {sec_files_outside}

rules.reason: {sec_outside} credential-shaped hits outside tests ({sec_kinds}) - an agent must neither read nor propagate them

components.name: rule line: test fixtures contain fake keys - do not 'fix' or redact them
PreToolUse secret-scan on Write/Edit with a test-path allowlist

rules.reason: {sec_total} hits, all in test files - fake keys; without an allowlist a naive scan hook blocks every test edit

components.name: deny Read/Edit on {sens_n} sensitive files ({sens_sample})

rules.reason: {sens_n} sensitive-by-name files - out of the agent's context by default

components.name: rule line: 'this repository cannot be built here' - no build or test claims
Windows build runner (msbuild + VS build tools) reachable by a build-on-runner skill
build-on-runner skill (submit, wait, fetch log)

rules.reason: {sln_n} .sln, {tfm} targets, {snk_n} .snk - msbuild on Windows only; an agent on Linux must say so instead of guessing

components.name: Dataverse MCP server candidate (official Power Platform MCP, read-only scope first)
rule line: entity/attribute names come from Dataverse metadata, never guessed
deny plugin registration / solution import commands

rules.reason: {dv_n} Dataverse/CRM SDK references - schema lives in the environment, not in the repo

rules.when: any(k in d['external_systems'] for k in ('PostgreSQL','MySQL/MariaDB','SQL Server'))

components.name: rule line: schema changes go through the migration tool ({db_kinds}); no ad-hoc SQL
read-only DB MCP candidate - only if a local/compose DB exists ({compose})

rules.reason: {db_kinds} referenced in manifests/compose

rules.when: any(k in d['external_systems'] for k in ('AWS SDK','Azure SDK','GCP SDK'))

components.name: deny mutating cloud CLI (aws/az/gcloud create|delete|deploy)
rule line: cloud credentials are never in the repo or the agent's env

rules.reason: {cloud} referenced - an agent with a shell must not be able to touch live infrastructure

rules.signal: existing tool-specific AI config (cursor / clinerules / copilot-instructions)
rules.when: any(k in d['ai_config']['kinds'] for k in ('cursor','clinerules','copilot','windsurf','kiro'))

components.name: merge {ai_kinds} into one AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md = '@AGENTS.md' import
report: do not duplicate - {ai_n} AI files already exist

rules.reason: {ai_kinds} present ({ai_n} files) - a second, disagreeing instruction file is worse than none

rules.when: any(k in d['ai_config']['kinds'] for k in ('AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md'))

components.name: delta only: append diagnosis facts missing from the existing file ({ai_missing})

rules.reason: instruction file exists ({ai_files}) - generate only what the diagnosis proves and the file lacks

components.name: CLAUDE.md from the diagnosis: build={build_cmd}; test={test_cmd}; lint={lint}; layout

rules.reason: no CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/cursor/copilot - the agent starts from zero facts; the diagnosis provides them

rules.when: sum(l['files'] for l in d['languages'] if l['language']=='Jupyter') >= 3

components.name: rule line: edit cells with NotebookEdit, never the raw .ipynb JSON; keep outputs as committed
PostToolUse: nbformat validate on any .ipynb write
deny bulk reformatters over notebooks/

rules.reason: {nb_n} notebooks - a JSON-level edit corrupts them and the diff is unreviewable

components.name: PreToolUse: allow terraform fmt/validate/plan; deny apply/destroy/import/state
terraform-docs regen skill (README tables are generated from variables.tf)
rule line: plan is the deliverable; apply is a human's

rules.reason: {tf_n} .tf files; pre-commit runs {tf_lint} - README/variables co-change {tf_pair} times in history

components.name: PostToolUse: run {formatter} on the edited file

rules.reason: {lint} configured - style is mechanical; a hook removes it from review

components.name: rule line: match the surrounding style; no reformatting of untouched lines
report: no lint config - style drift is not machine-checked

rules.reason: no lint/format config - a formatter hook would reformat files nobody formatted before

rules.signal: substantial docs (README >= 8 KB or docs/ folder or architecture doc)

components.name: rule line: read {doc_pointer} before planning
docs-sync skill: a change that alters behaviour updates {doc_pointer}

rules.reason: README {readme_kb} KB, {docs_files} docs files, arch docs: {arch} - the answers exist; the agent must be pointed at them

rules.signal: thin docs (no README or < 2 KB, no docs/)

components.name: onboarding doc from the diagnosis (layout, build, test, external systems)

rules.reason: README {readme_kb} KB and no docs/ - nothing for the agent (or a new hire) to read

components.name: run the agent inside {env_kind}; same toolchain as CI

rules.reason: {env_kind} present - the reproducible environment already exists

rules.signal: legacy web stack (PHP + vendored jQuery / Twig)
rules.when: 'PHP' in langs(d) and ('jquery' in d['frameworks'] or 'jQuery (vendored)' in d['frameworks'])

components.name: security reviewer subagent (XSS / SQL injection / CSRF) on every PHP or JS change
rule line: no framework migrations or jQuery removal; smallest change that fits
deny edits under translation dirs ({i18n_dir}) - owned by the translation platform

rules.reason: PHP ({php_files} files) with jQuery; hot dirs include {i18n_dir} ({i18n_changes} changes) which is machine-synced

rules.signal: binaries / package caches / IDE state tracked in git

components.name: deny Read/Edit under packages/, bin/, obj/, .vs/ ({bin_n} binaries, {pkg_n} package files tracked)
report: repository hygiene - tracked binaries inflate every agent context and clone

rules.reason: {bin_n} dll/exe/pdb, {pkg_n} package-cache files, {ide_n} IDE files in git - the agent would read them as code

rules.when: 'android' in d['frameworks'] or 'flutter/dart' in d['frameworks'] or 'react-native (sub-package)' in d['frameworks']

components.name: emulator-free verification skill: JVM unit tests + screenshot tests ({screenshot})
Android SDK on the runner; full ./gradlew build is minutes, not seconds

rules.reason: mobile toolchain ({mobile}) - instrumented tests need a device; the agent verifies with what runs on JVM

rules.signal: several build systems in one repo
rules.when: len([s for s in d['build']['system'] if s in ('maven','gradle','cargo','dotnet','msbuild','go','composer','turborepo')]) >= 2

components.name: rule line: keep {build_systems} in sync ({build_pair_times} co-changes in history)

rules.reason: {build_systems} both present - a dependency added to one and not the other breaks CI on the other

components.name: contribution-style skill: PR format, commit convention, CONTRIBUTING ({contrib})

rules.reason: {authors} authors in the sample - output must look like everyone else's PR to be merged

rules.when: any(k in d['external_systems'] for k in ('OpenAI API','Anthropic API'))

components.name: rule line: tests never call live model APIs; provider keys are not in the agent's env
deny reading *_API_KEY env / .env

rules.reason: {llm} referenced - a test run that hits the real API costs money and is non-deterministic

components.name: rule line: dependency bumps = {dep_files} together; never edit a lock file by hand

rules.reason: {dep_files} co-change {dep_times} times - the most frequent change shape in history is a dependency bump

components.name: rule line: run through the AppHost project; services are not started individually
Docker on the runner (Aspire containers: {containers})

rules.reason: Aspire AppHost orchestrates {containers}; 'dotnet run' on one service is not the system

rules.signal: PCF control / web resources beside a CRM backend

components.name: rule line: PCF controls build with `npm run build` in their own folder (pac pcf); CRM plugins do not
per-area CLAUDE.md: Pcf/ (node) vs CrmEntryPoints/ (msbuild)

rules.reason: two toolchains in one solution - a node build works here, the .NET one does not
